title: Pupil campus
description: One row of the 16-19 pupil campus data file, as the data specification defines it, headed by field reference: one row per student, with the campus the student is allocated to and the student's attainment programme entries and point scores. The descriptive column heading is the heading of the CSV a school downloads, in column order A-AI. The same columns are in the provisional, revised and retention files.

CYPMD_ID.description: Student index number (for use in checking exercise)

DOB.description: Student date of birth in format DD/MM/YYYY

AGE.description: Student age at beginning of the reporting year

attendance_year_0.description: Student included in this school or college's results for the 2025/26 academic year

attendance_year_1.description: Student included in this school or college's results for the 2024/25 academic year

attendance_year_2.description: Student included in this school or college's results for the 2023/24 academic year

LAESTAB.description: DfE number for school or college

URN.description: School or college Unique Reference Number

UKPRN.description: School or college UK Provider Registration Number

KS4_DISADVANTAGE.description: Student counts as disadvantaged during KS4 (so count in institution's disadvantage breakdown on headline indicators (attainment, progress, retention, and English and maths progress)

x-csv.heading: Student counts as disadvantaged during KS4 (eligible for FSM or looked after for more than 6 months)

x-display.label: Student counts as disadvantaged during KS4 (eligible for FSM or looked after for more than 6 months)

ALEV.description: Student entered for at least one A level or AS level (1 = yes, 0 = no). A levels include GCE/applied A levels, GCE/applied AS and applied A level Double Awards.

TOTENTS_ALEV.description: Total entries for A level, ie this student's contribution to their institution's published average point scores in A levels.

x-csv.heading: Total size of entries in A levels

x-display.label: Total size of entries in A levels

TOTPTSE_ALEV.description: Total points achieved in A levels at grades A*-E that contribute to their institution's published average point scores in A levels.

x-csv.heading: Total point score in A levels

x-display.label: Total point score in A levels

ACAD.description: Student entered for at least one academic qualification (1 = yes, 0 = no). Covers A levels plus other academic level 3 qualifications.

TOTENTS_ACAD.description: Total entries in academic qualifications, ie this student's contribution to their institution's published average point scores in academic qualifications.

x-csv.heading: Total size of entries in academic qualifications

x-display.label: Total size of entries in academic qualifications

TOTPTSE_ACAD.description: Total points achieved in academic qualifications that contribute to their institution's published average point scores (in academic qualifications).

x-csv.heading: Total point score in academic qualifications

x-display.label: Total point score in academic qualifications

TLEV.description: Student entered for at least one tech level (level 3 tech level qualifications, 1 = yes, 0 = no).

x-csv.heading: Total size of entries in tech levels

x-display.label: Total size of entries in tech levels

TOTPTSE_TLEV.description: Total points achieved in tech levels that contribute to their institution's published average point scores (in tech levels).

AGEN.description: Student entered for at least one applied general qualification (level 3 applied general qualifications, 1 = yes, 0 = no).
